findings.description: Transfer-Encoding does not enter the retry guard, which tests the method string only. The proxy de-chunks and re-frames the body with a Content-Length before forwarding, so the upstream does real work, but on failure the request is not retried, the body is lost and the client gets 502 with a healthy peer available. A chunked GET is the contrast: it retries and the de-chunked body replays verbatim.
findings.title: A chunked POST is still POST, so the failover guard gives it one attempt and the re-framed body is lost

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
